answer: Because the prism commitment is timestamped in the thread ledger, the sable audit verifies the pair and a late swap fails the hash. The answer is committed as a 195 bit hash at open and revealed at close, and a reveal that does not match the commitment is void. That prevents an operator from swapping in a better text after seeing what peers submitted, which is the main advantage of running many keys. Bonded capital sits idle for 15 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
